jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 25a (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/best-of.mjs, tools/budgets.mjs, tools/status.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/main). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/best-of.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/best-of.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- SENSITIVE (money: paid lanes / budgets / spend). Line 158 `} catch {}`: SILENT-<nonzero git exit code> (`git worktree remove --force` failing because the worktree was never registered or already gone), log the rest (e.g. permission errors); no fallback value, best-effort cleanup.
- Line 161 `} catch {}`: cleanup with `{ recursive: true, force: true }` on fs.rm (can't ENOENT) — LOG-ALWAYS, include the tmp path; no fallback value, best-effort cleanup.

### tools/budgets.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/budgets.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- SENSITIVE (money: paid lanes / budgets / spend). Line 155 `... try { if (new URL(finalUrl).host !== new URL(url).host) {...} } catch { /* an unreadable address is not a reason to refuse */ } ...`: SILENT-TypeError (`new URL()` on a malformed finalUrl/url), log the rest; no fallback value, the host check is simply skipped.
- Line 179 `const serial = fn => { const run = queue.then(fn, fn); queue = run.catch(() => {}); return run; };`: LEAVE — promise-queue serializer; the real rejection still reaches the caller through the returned `run` promise.

### tools/status.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/status.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- SENSITIVE (money: paid lanes / budgets / spend). Line 29 `} catch { /* Unreadable or corrupt runs do not hide usable history. */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/SyntaxError (run's state.json missing or torn), log the rest; no fallback value, the run is left out of `runs`.
- Line 65 `catch { /* A missing ledger should not prevent status. */ }` (around `spend = await spendToday();`): SILENT-ENOENT (no spend ledger yet), log the rest (e.g. a real bug computing spend); keep the already-initialized `spend = { usd: null, byLane: {} }` fallback.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
